gloss: to challenge, to confront, to take on

definitions.gloss: to challenge, to confront, to take on
definitions.explanation: To boldly face a difficult opponent, task, or situation. Implies courage and determination in the face of difficulty. Often used with に to mark the challenge being faced.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{課題|かだい}に{挑|いど}む。
examples.english: I take on a new challenge.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}チャンピオンに{挑|いど}む{若|わか}い{選手|せんしゅ}がいる。
examples.english: There is a young athlete challenging the world champion.

examples.japanese: {失敗|しっぱい}を{恐|おそ}れず、{何度|なんど}でも{挑|いど}む{姿勢|しせい}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to have the attitude of taking on challenges again and again without fearing failure.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). The challenge or opponent is marked with に: Xに{挑|いど}む.

ASPECT (ている):
{挑|いど}んでいる describes an ongoing challenge or confrontation.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- Xに{挑|いど}む: to challenge X, to take on X

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試合|しあい}に{挑|いど}む: to take on a match
- {記録|きろく}に{挑|いど}む: to attempt to break a record
- {難題|なんだい}に{挑|いど}む: to tackle a difficult problem
- {挑|いど}む{姿勢|しせい}: a challenging attitude, willingness to take on challenges

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {挑戦|ちょうせん}する: to challenge (suru verb, more common in everyday speech)
- {立|た}ち{向|む}かう: to stand up against, to confront
